title: A.K. Gopalan v. State of Madras
description: Early constitutional interpretation of personal liberty under Article 21 and preventive detention; later jurisprudence expanded due process reading.

title: I.C. Golaknath v. State of Punjab
description: Held Parliament could not amend Fundamental Rights at that stage, later revisited in Kesavananda Bharati.

title: Kesavananda Bharati v. State of Kerala
description: Established Basic Structure doctrine: Parliament's amending power under Article 368 cannot alter Constitution's basic structure.

title: Indira Nehru Gandhi v. Raj Narain
description: Applied Basic Structure doctrine to strike down constitutional amendment impacting judicial review and free elections.

title: ADM Jabalpur v. Shivkant Shukla
description: Emergency-era habeas corpus ruling; subsequently disapproved in later constitutional jurisprudence including Puttaswamy.

title: Maneka Gandhi v. Union of India
description: Expanded Article 21 by reading fairness, non-arbitrariness and reasonableness into procedure established by law.

title: Minerva Mills v. Union of India
description: Reinforced Basic Structure; balanced Fundamental Rights and Directive Principles.

title: Indra Sawhney v. Union of India
description: Landmark ruling on reservation policy, backward classes and creamy layer doctrine.

title: S.R. Bommai v. Union of India
description: Laid standards for Article 356 use and strengthened federalism and secularism principles.

title: D.K. Basu v. State of West Bengal
description: Issued guidelines to prevent custodial torture and deaths; mandated arrest and detention safeguards.

title: Prakash Singh v. Union of India
description: Directed structural police reforms to improve autonomy, accountability and rule of law compliance.

title: NALSA v. Union of India
description: Recognized rights of transgender persons under Constitution and affirmed dignity and equality protections.

title: Justice K.S. Puttaswamy v. Union of India
description: Declared right to privacy as a fundamental right under Part III.

title: Navtej Singh Johar v. Union of India
description: Read down Section 377 IPC to decriminalize consensual same-sex relations between adults.

title: Shayara Bano v. Union of India
description: Set aside instant triple talaq practice as unconstitutional.

title: Joseph Shine v. Union of India
description: Struck down Section 497 IPC (adultery) as unconstitutional for violating dignity and equality.

title: Common Cause v. Union of India
description: Recognized right to die with dignity and validated passive euthanasia safeguards.

title: Ayodhya Judgment (M. Siddiq v. Mahant Suresh Das)
description: Settled title dispute with directions on trust formation and alternate land allotment.

title: Anuradha Bhasin v. Union of India
description: Held that internet access restrictions must be temporary, proportionate and subject to periodic review.

title: Internet and speech jurisprudence developments
description: Subsequent constitutional adjudication continued proportionality-based review in rights-restriction cases.

title: Kaushal Kishor v. State of UP
description: Discussed scope of free speech, state accountability and constitutional remedies in public law context.

title: S.G. Vombatkere v. Union of India
description: Proceedings led to effective suspension of sedition prosecutions under Section 124A IPC pending reconsideration.

title: Supriyo @ Supriya Chakraborty v. Union of India
description: Constitution bench considered marriage equality claims and scope of judicial review in personal law/statutory domain.

title: Arbitration and commercial law line of cases
description: Recent Supreme Court trend emphasizes limited judicial interference and speedy dispute resolution in arbitration.
